meta.description: Overview display of pending authorization messages for a credit card account with scrolling functionality and drill-down into detail view.
meta.process_description: The program provides clerks with a paginated list view of all open/pending authorization requests (Pending Authorizations) for an entered credit card account. The user enters an account number, whereupon the program loads the associated account, customer, and card master data and retrieves the pending authorization records from an IMS database – up to 5 entries per page. Selecting an individual entry (flag 'S') redirects the user to the detail view (COPAUS1C), where complete information on the respective authorization can be viewed. Navigation is handled via function keys: PF7 (previous page), PF8 (next page), PF3 (return to main menu).

files.ACCTDAT: Account master file – contains credit account data (limit, balance, status)
files.CUSTDAT: Customer master file – contains customer master data (name, address)
files.CARDDAT: Card master file – contains credit card data (card number, status)
files.CXACAIX: Account-to-card cross-reference index – enables lookup by card number via account number
files.CCXREF: Card-customer-account cross-reference file – links card number to customer and account number
files.PSBPAUTB: IMS database (PSB) for pending authorization data – contains summary and detail segments of pending authorizations

business_rules: The account number (Account ID) is a mandatory field and must be numeric – empty or non-numeric inputs are rejected with an error message.
A maximum of 5 pending authorization entries are displayed per screen page.
For the detail view, only selection code 'S' (Select) is valid – any other value results in an error message.
Backward navigation (PF7) is only possible if the current page number is greater than 1 – on the first page, a corresponding informational message is displayed.
Page navigation keys (IMS keys) are stored in the communication area for up to 20 previous pages to enable correct backward navigation.
On the initial call (EIBCALEN = 0), the communication area is initialized and an empty overview screen is displayed.
The mapping from account number to card number and customer data is performed via cross-reference files (CCXREF/CXACAIX) – if an entry is missing, no authorization record is displayed.
In the event of database errors (IMS status codes BA, FH, TE), a retry mechanism is triggered.
PF3 always returns to the main menu (COMEN01C), regardless of the current display state.

variables.name: WS-PAUT-SMRY-SEG-FLG
variables.description: Status flag indicating whether a summary segment for pending authorizations (Pending Authorization Summary) was successfully found in the IMS database PSBPAUTB. Controls the subsequent processing flow: authorization entries can only be displayed on the screen if this flag is set.

variables.name: FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
variables.description: Condition value: The summary segment for pending authorizations was found in the IMS database. The program can read and display the authorization data contained therein for the requested account.

variables.name: NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
variables.description: Condition value: No summary segment for pending authorizations was found in the IMS database. The account either has no pending authorizations or the record does not exist – the overview list remains empty.

variables.name: WS-ERR-FLG
variables.description: General error flag for the current processing cycle. Is set as soon as a business or technical error has occurred (e.g., invalid account number, incorrect selection code, database error). Prevents further processing and controls the display of an error message on the screen.

variables.name: ERR-FLG-ON
variables.description: Condition value: An error has occurred. The program displays an error message to the user and aborts normal processing (e.g., database access, page navigation).

variables.name: ERR-FLG-OFF
variables.description: Condition value: No error has occurred. Processing is running without errors and the program can build and display the authorization overview normally.

variables.name: WS-AUTHS-EOF
variables.description: Flag indicating whether the end of the authorization list in the IMS database has been reached. Is set during scrolling through pending authorizations as soon as no further entries exist for the account. Controls forward navigation (PF8) and the display of the 'Next Page' indicator.

variables.name: AUTHS-EOF
variables.description: Condition value: All pending authorization entries for the account have been read from the IMS database. There is no further page – forward navigation (PF8) is no longer possible.

variables.name: AUTHS-NOT-EOF
variables.description: Condition value: Further pending authorization entries exist in the IMS database that have not yet been displayed. The user can scroll to the next page using PF8.

variables.name: WS-SEND-ERASE-FLG
variables.description: Control flag for CICS screen output. Determines whether the screen should be completely cleared before displaying the authorization overview (ERASE option on SEND MAP). The screen is cleared on the initial display of the map; clearing can be suppressed for pure error messages or partial updates.

variables.name: SEND-ERASE-YES
variables.description: Condition value: The screen is completely cleared before the authorization overview is displayed. Typically used when the overview map is displayed for the first time or after a page change.

variables.name: SEND-ERASE-NO
variables.description: Condition value: The screen is not cleared but only partially updated. Used when only an error message or a notice is to be displayed on top of the existing screen content.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-INFO
variables.description: Group field in the communication area (COMMAREA) that holds all cross-session control and navigation data for the Pending Authorization overview (COPAUS0C). Enables the passing of page position, selection status, and IMS database keys between successive CICS transaction calls.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SEL-FLG
variables.description: Selection flag entered by the user in the overview list to select an authorization entry for the detail view. Only the value 'S' (Select) is valid – any other value results in an error message. Is stored between transaction calls in the communication area.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED
variables.description: IMS database key of the authorization entry selected by the user. Is passed to the detail program (e.g., COPAUD0C) during drill-down into the detail view so that it can load the correct authorization record from the IMS database PSBPAUTB.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG
variables.description: Array of IMS database keys of the first authorization entries of up to 20 previously visited pages. Enables correct backward navigation (PF7): when scrolling back, the stored key of the target page is used to position the IMS database at the correct location and rebuild the page.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST
variables.description: IMS database key of the last authorization entry displayed on the current page. Serves as the starting point for forward navigation (PF8): when scrolling forward, the next record is read from the IMS database starting from this key.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-PAGE-NUM
variables.description: Current page number of the authorization overview, stored in the cross-session communication area. Is updated with each forward or backward scroll and displayed on the screen. Also controls the availability of backward navigation (PF7 is only active when the page number is greater than 1).

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-NEXT-PAGE-FLG
variables.description: Flag in the communication area indicating whether further authorization entries exist beyond the currently displayed page. Controls the activation of forward navigation (PF8) on the screen and is stored between transaction calls.

variables.name: NEXT-PAGE-YES
variables.description: Condition value: At least one further page of pending authorization entries exists. The user can navigate to the next page using PF8.

variables.name: NEXT-PAGE-NO
variables.description: Condition value: The currently displayed page is the last page of the authorization overview. Forward navigation (PF8) is not possible.

variables.name: CDEMO-CPVS-AUTH-KEYS
variables.description: Array of IMS database keys of up to 5 authorization entries currently displayed on the screen. Used to determine the correct IMS key of a selected entry when the user makes a selection (selection code 'S') and to provide it for drill-down into the detail view.

variables.name: PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
variables.description: Record structure for the summary segment of pending authorizations from the IMS database PSBPAUTB. Contains the summarized header data of an authorization group for a credit card account, displayed as an overview line on the screen (e.g., amount, date, status).

variables.name: PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS
variables.description: Record structure for the detail segment of a pending authorization from the IMS database PSBPAUTB. Contains the complete details of an authorization transaction (e.g., merchant data, exact amounts, approval code), displayed in the detail view after a drill-down.

variables.name: DFHCOMMAREA
variables.description: CICS communication area (COMMAREA) used to exchange data between successive program calls within the CICS transaction. Contains all session-relevant information such as user context, account number, navigation status, and IMS keys that must be retained between individual screen interactions.

variables.name: LK-COMMAREA
variables.description: Technical placeholder for the CICS communication area in the LINKAGE SECTION. Defines the entry point for the passed session data; the actual structure (CARDDEMO-COMMAREA with CDEMO-CPVS-INFO) is overlaid via REDEFINES or addressing to access account number, navigation status, and user information.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.description: MAIN-PARA is the central control paragraph of the program: it detects the call context (initial call vs. return), evaluates the function key pressed, and thereby controls the entire processing logic of the pending authorization overview.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.description: Processes the clerk's input after the Enter key is pressed: validates the entered account number, evaluates any line selection from the authorization list, and forwards to the detail view if a valid 'S' selection is made.

paragraphs.name: GATHER-DETAILS
paragraphs.description: Orchestrates the complete data retrieval for an entered credit card account: resets the display, loads all relevant master data, and prepares the first page of pending authorizations.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PF7-KEY
paragraphs.description: Navigates to the previous page of the pending authorization overview (PF7 backward scrolling). If the user is already on page 1, a message is displayed indicating that no further backward navigation is possible.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PF8-KEY
paragraphs.description: Processes the clerk's forward-scroll request (PF8): checks whether another page of pending authorizations exists and loads it, or informs the user that they are already on the last page.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
paragraphs.description: Loads the next page of up to 5 pending authorization entries from the IMS database and determines whether a further subsequent page exists, in order to correctly control forward navigation (PF8).

paragraphs.name: GET-AUTHORIZATIONS
paragraphs.description: Retrieves the next pending authorization record from the IMS database and evaluates the result functionally – either a valid authorization entry is present, the list is exhausted, or a system error is reported to the clerk.

paragraphs.name: REPOSITION-AUTHORIZATIONS
paragraphs.description: Positions the IMS database to a previously saved authorization entry in order to resume the list view at the correct position in the authorization history after a page change.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-AUTH-LIST
paragraphs.description: Formats a single pending authorization entry for screen display and places it in the correct list position (1–5) of the current overview page. Amount, date, time, authorization type, approval status, and reconciliation status are formatted to be readable by the clerk.

paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-AUTH-DATA
paragraphs.description: Resets all five display rows of the authorization overview to a blank, neutral initial state. This ensures that no outdated authorization data from the previous screen remains visible when the next page is built.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.description: This paragraph controls the return to the previous application or to the sign-on screen. It transfers control to the calling program and passes along the origin information of the current session.

paragraphs.name: SEND-PAULST-SCREEN
paragraphs.description: This paragraph displays the formatted overview list of pending authorizations on the screen. It cleanly closes any open IMS database resources beforehand and sends the paginated list map with all header data, authorization entries, and any error messages to the clerk.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-PAULST-SCREEN
paragraphs.description: Receives the pending authorization overview map filled in by the clerk – including the entered account number, selection indicator ('S'), and function key pressed – and makes these inputs available for further processing.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.description: Populates the header area of the overview map with program identification data as well as the current system date and time, so that the clerk can always identify which program they are using and when the display was generated.

paragraphs.name: GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS
paragraphs.description: This paragraph loads all relevant master and transaction data for a credit card account and prepares it for display on the overview screen. It consolidates account, customer, card, and authorization data into a complete clerk view.

paragraphs.name: GETCARDXREF-BYACCT
paragraphs.description: Determines the card number and customer number associated with an entered account number via the cross-reference index, in order to establish the link between account, card, and cardholder.

paragraphs.name: GETACCTDATA-BYACCT
paragraphs.description: Loads the account master record for the entered account number from the account master file (ACCTDAT) in order to provide the credit limit, balance, and account status for the overview display. If the account is not found or cannot be read, a meaningful error message is displayed to the clerk.

paragraphs.name: GETCUSTDATA-BYCUST
paragraphs.description: Loads the customer master record using the customer number retrieved from the cross-reference, in order to provide the customer data (name, address) for the display overview. If the access fails, a meaningful error message is displayed to the clerk on the overview map.

paragraphs.name: GET-AUTH-SUMMARY
paragraphs.description: Retrieves the summary segment of pending authorizations for the entered credit card account from the IMS database. This record is a prerequisite for the subsequent display of the authorization list and confirms whether any pending authorization data exists for the account at all.

paragraphs.name: SCHEDULE-PSB
paragraphs.description: Establishes the connection to the IMS database (PSBPAUTB) in order to subsequently retrieve the pending authorization data for the credit card account. If a database access is already active, it is first cleanly terminated and then re-established.
